description: For every standard index \(e\), the indices \(p(e,0)\) and \(p(e,1)\) are distinct. The specified \(b_e\) is total computable, satisfies \(\varphi_{b_e(j)}(x)\simeq\varphi_j(x)\) for every \(j,x\), and sends both padded indices to the same number. Thus an effective compiler preserving every partial function can collapse padded names.
